string-array.item:
Hamilton Facilities
- Indoor Courts: We have two indoor courts on campus, including UniRec's Sports Hall and the School of Education Court.
- Outdoor Courts: Our re-purposed outdoor courts include basketball, netball and tennis courts.
- Outdoor Fields: We have large field space on campus, which can be used for touch, rugby, football, cricket and more.
- Wellbeing Hub: Find out how you can become part of a community that is engaged, connected and inspired through the Wellbeing Hub.
- Activity Spaces: UniRec has an Activity Room for hire, perfect for small groups requiring a mirror for dance.
- Esports Arena: With the development of the Esports Arena, the University of Waikato is committed to leading the way in esports in NZ.
- Waikato parkrun: A free, fun, and friendly weekly 5k community event. Walk, jog, run, volunteer or spectate - it's up to you!
- Squash Courts: We have squash courts on campus, check out UniRec Squash Courts.
- Fitness Island: Free for anyone to use, why not try a workout on our new outdoor fitness island equipment.
- Cricket Nets: Located close to the Don Llewellyn Pavilion, there are three cricket nets available for hire.
Tauranga Facilities
- Queen Elizabeth Youth Centre (QEYC): A 20-minute walk or five-minute cycle from the Tauranga campus, the QEYC offers indoor courts, a weights room and group fitness classes.
- Tauranga Sports Fields: Bookable fields and courts at Fergusson Park, a short drive from the city campus.

Orientation & Welcome
- International Student Welcome: Meet the international team, your peers and the support staff who look after you.
- Campus Tours: Guided walks leave from the Student Centre every weekday during the first two weeks of semester.
- Clubs Day: Every club and society sets up a stall on the Village Green - the fastest way to find your people.

What's On This Month
- Research Seminar Series: Weekly talks from Waikato researchers, open to all students, Tuesday 4pm in the Gallagher Academy of Performing Arts.
- Lunchtime Recitals: Free concerts by music students and visiting artists, Thursdays 12pm.
- Careers Expo: Meet more than 60 employers and hear what they look for in graduates, Level 1, Student Centre.
- Matariki Celebrations: Kapa haka, kai and workshops across the week of Matariki.
- Postgraduate Information Evening: Talk to supervisors about masters and doctoral study.
- Sustainability Workshop: Learn how the campus is reducing waste and how you can get involved.

Academic & Faculty Clubs
- Engineering Society: Site visits, design challenges and the annual robotics competition.
- Law Students' Association: Mooting, careers evenings and networking with local firms.
- Computer Science Club: Weekly coding sessions, hackathons and help with internship applications.
- Science Society: Field trips, lab tours and guest talks from researchers.

Sport & Recreation Clubs
- Waikato Rowing Club: Novice and competitive squads training on the Waikato River.
- Netball Club: Social and competitive teams, all levels welcome.
- Tramping Club: Weekend trips around the Waikato and central North Island.
- Esports Club: Casual and competitive teams for Valorant, League of Legends and more.

Cultural & Community Clubs
- Waikato International Students' Association: Cultural nights, buddy programmes and language exchanges.
- Māori Students' Association: Whakawhanaungatanga events and academic support.
- Debating Society: Weekly debates and the inter-university tournament.
- Volunteering Waikato: One-off and ongoing community projects near campus.

Academic Support
- Library and Learning Services: Subject librarians, referencing workshops and one-to-one research help.
- Te Kura Toi Tangata Writing Support: Feedback on essays, reports and drafts, bookable online.

Health & Wellbeing
- Student Health Centre: Doctors and nurses on campus, appointments available weekdays.
- Counselling Service: Free, confidential appointments with qualified counsellors.
- Accessibility Services: Support plans, note-taking and assistive technology for students with disabilities.

Money & Life
- Student Finances: Budgeting advice, hardship grants and scholarship information.
- International Student Support: Visa questions, insurance and orientation programmes.
- Careers and Employability: CV checks, mock interviews and job search coaching.
- Emergency Contact: Campus Security is available 24/7 on 0800 924 528 for urgent help.
